title: Patient Financial Services Policy: One Open Patient Payment Plan per Patient
content:
**Section 1. Limit.** A patient holds at most 1 open plan under the Patient Payment Plans. New eligible charges are added to that plan as add-ons rather than opening a second plan.

**Section 2. Condition for a new proposal.** A payment plan is proposed to a patient only where the patient holds no other payment plan in status proposed, active, delinquent or defaulted. The condition is judged on the system record of the patient's payment plans before the proposal is made, matched to the patient for whom the plan is proposed; what the patient says about other plans does not replace that record.

**Section 3. Defaulted plans.** A defaulted plan still counts while it can be reinstated. Once its reinstatement window has passed, it no longer blocks a new plan.

**Section 4. Family members.** Plans of family members are separate holdings under each patient's own profile; a parent's plan and a child's plan are counted each under the patient to whom it belongs.

### Status table

The status of each other plan the patient holds decides whether it stands in the way of a new proposal:

| Status of the patient's other plan | Counts against the limit of 1 |
|---|---|
| Proposed | Yes |
| Active | Yes |
| Delinquent | Yes |
| Defaulted, reinstatement window not yet passed | Yes |
| Defaulted, reinstatement window passed | No |
| Paid off, cancelled or withdrawn | No (not among the statuses in Section 2) |

### Illustrations (hypothetical)

- A patient whose only earlier plan is paid off may be proposed a new plan; the paid-off plan is not in any of the four statuses in Section 2.
- A patient holding an active plan who incurs a new eligible charge is not proposed a second plan; the charge is added to the active plan as an add-on.
- A patient whose earlier plan defaulted and whose reinstatement window on that plan has already passed is not blocked by it.
- A patient whose spouse holds an active plan under the spouse's own profile is not blocked by that plan.
